children: KKR & Co Inc (NYSE:KKR) packed Q2 with exits and deals: selling USI to Aon for $17B, closing eight major asset exits, buying Ci FLAVORS, joining a C$2.7B JV on Westcoast pipeline, retaining Atlantic Aviation exposure, and settling a $250M DOJ civil claim.
KKR Agreed To Sell USI Insurance
: KKR agreed to sell USI Insurance to Aon for $17B in cash, deal expected to close Q4 2026 pending approvals. KKR bought USI in 2017 and realized roughly 6× return.
: KKR agreed to a $250M DOJ civil settlement over alleged HSR filing lapses tied to at least 16 2021–2022 deals. Payment by a KKR unit is to be reimbursed by outside law firms.
KKR Exits Eight Assets In Q2 2026
: KKR (KKR) completed eight major asset exits in Q2 2026, including Kokusai Electric, HD Hyundai Marine Solution, BrightSpring Health, OHB SE and OneStream Software.
KKR Enters Enbridge JV For Westcoast
: KKR joins Apollo in a C$2.7B JV with Enbridge to fund Westcoast pipeline expansions. KKR will take an indirect noncontrolling stake and begin receiving distributions as projects come online.
: KKR remains a major Atlantic Aviation shareholder after Apollo’s funds bought a sizable stake in a partnership valuing Atlantic near $10B; deal aims to back fleet FBO growth and concession assets
: KKR agreed to buy Japanese beauty platform Ci FLAVORS; founder and CEO will reinvest alongside KKR. Deal via KKR Asia Pacific PE funds. KKR shares closed down 1.07% at $107.32.
